decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 25-3918-9STC-LP-001; 25-3918-9STC-BP-001; 25-3918-9STC-EL-001-R1; 25-3918-9STC-EL-002; 25-3918-9STC-EL-003 (November 2025); 25-3918-9STC-EL-004-R1; 25-3918-9STC-EL-005; 25-3918-9STC-EL-006 (November 2025); 25-3918-9STC-WA-001-R1; 25-3918-9STC-WA-007; 25-3918-9STC-WA-008; 25-3918-9STC-WA-009; Flush Casement Drawings (24mm DGU) from Timeless Windows & Doors; Timber Sash with Cords and Weights Drawings (24mm DGU) from Timeless Windows & Doors; Timber Sash with Spiral Balance Drawings (24mm DGU) from Timeless Windows & Doors; Timber Sash with Cords and Weights Drawings (14mm DGU+25mm transom) from Timeless Windows & Doors; Design and Access Statement from Thomas & Thomas dated June 2025 (x 5 pages); Planning Statement from Thomas & Thomas dated June 2025 (x 6 pages).

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The sash windows on the side and rear elevations of the building, as shown on the approved drawings listed in condition 2, shall be implemented with the inclusion of sash horns and shall thereafter be maintained and retained in that form, unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Replacement of existing single glazed timber windows and door with double glazed timber windows and door to the front, side and rear elevations.
